ayahs.arabicText: حٰمٓۚ
ayahs.translation: Ha'. Mim.

ayahs.arabicText: تَنْزِیْلٌ مِّنَ الرَّحْمٰنِ الرَّحِیْمِۚ
ayahs.translation: This is a revelation from the Most Merciful, the Most Compassionate,

ayahs.arabicText: كِتٰبٌ فُصِّلَتْ اٰیٰتُهٗ قُرْاٰنًا عَرَبِیًّا لِّقَوْمٍ یَّعْلَمُوْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: a Book whose verses have been well-expounded; an Arabic Qur'an for those who have knowledge,

ayahs.arabicText: بَشِیْرًا وَّ نَذِیْرًا١ۚ فَاَعْرَضَ اَكْثَرُهُمْ فَهُمْ لَا یَسْمَعُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: one bearing good news and warning. Yet most of them turned away and are not wont to give heed.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ قَالُوْا قُلُوْبُنَا فِیْۤ اَكِنَّةٍ مِّمَّا تَدْعُوْنَاۤ اِلَیْهِ وَ فِیْۤ اٰذَانِنَا وَقْرٌ وَّ مِنْۢ بَیْنِنَا وَ بَیْنِكَ حِجَابٌ فَاعْمَلْ اِنَّنَا عٰمِلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: They say: “Our hearts are securely wrapped up against what you call us to, and in our ears is a heaviness, and between you and us there is a veil. So act; we too are acting.”

ayahs.arabicText: قُلْ اِنَّمَاۤ اَنَا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُكُمْ یُوْحٰۤى اِلَیَّ اَنَّمَاۤ اِلٰهُكُمْ اِلٰهٌ وَّاحِدٌ فَاسْتَقِیْمُوْۤا اِلَیْهِ وَ اسْتَغْفِرُوْهُ١ؕ وَ وَیْلٌ لِّلْمُشْرِكِیْنَۙ
ayahs.translation: Tell them, (O Prophet): “I am only a human being like you. It is revealed to me that your God is One God; so direct yourselves straight to Him, and seek His forgiveness. Woe to those who associate others with Allah in His Divinity,

ayahs.arabicText: الَّذِیْنَ لَا یُؤْتُوْنَ الزَّكٰوةَ وَ هُمْ بِالْاٰخِرَةِ هُمْ كٰفِرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: who do not pay Zakah, and who deny the Hereafter.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّ الَّذِیْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَ عَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ لَهُمْ اَجْرٌ غَیْرُ مَمْنُوْنٍ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: As to those who have faith and do good works, surely theirs shall be a never-ending reward.

ayahs.arabicText: قُلْ اَئِنَّكُمْ لَتَكْفُرُوْنَ بِالَّذِیْ خَلَقَ الْاَرْضَ فِیْ یَوْمَیْنِ وَ تَجْعَلُوْنَ لَهٗۤ اَنْدَادًا١ؕ ذٰلِكَ رَبُّ الْعٰلَمِیْنَۚ
ayahs.translation: Tell them, (O Prophet): “Do you indeed disbelieve in Him and assign compeers to Him Who created the earth in two days? He is the Lord of all beings of the Universe.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ جَعَلَ فِیْهَا رَوَاسِیَ مِنْ فَوْقِهَا وَ بٰرَكَ فِیْهَا وَ قَدَّرَ فِیْهَاۤ اَقْوَاتَهَا فِیْۤ اَرْبَعَةِ اَیَّامٍ١ؕ سَوَآءً لِّلسَّآئِلِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: (After creating the earth) He set up firm mountains on it, blessed it, and provided it with sustenance in proportion to the needs of all who seek (sustenance). All this was done in four days.

ayahs.arabicText: ثُمَّ اسْتَوٰۤى اِلَى السَّمَآءِ وَ هِیَ دُخَانٌ فَقَالَ لَهَا وَ لِلْاَرْضِ ائْتِیَا طَوْعًا اَوْ كَرْهًا١ؕ قَالَتَاۤ اَتَیْنَا طَآئِعِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: Then He turned to the heaven while it was all smoke. He said to the heaven and the earth: “Come (into being), willingly or unwillingly.” They said: “Here we come (into being) in willing obeisance.”

ayahs.arabicText: فَقَضٰىهُنَّ سَبْعَ سَمٰوَاتٍ فِیْ یَوْمَیْنِ وَ اَوْحٰى فِیْ كُلِّ سَمَآءٍ اَمْرَهَا١ؕ وَ زَیَّنَّا السَّمَآءَ الدُّنْیَا بِمَصَابِیْحَ١ۖۗ وَ حِفْظًا١ؕ ذٰلِكَ تَقْدِیْرُ الْعَزِیْزِ الْعَلِیْمِ
ayahs.translation: Then He made them seven heavens in two days and revealed to each heaven its law. And We adorned the lower heaven with lamps, and firmly secured it. All this is the firm plan of the All-Mighty, the All-Knowing.

ayahs.arabicText: فَاِنْ اَعْرَضُوْا فَقُلْ اَنْذَرْتُكُمْ صٰعِقَةً مِّثْلَ صٰعِقَةِ عَادٍ وَّ ثَمُوْدَؕ
ayahs.translation: But if they turn away, tell them: “I warn you against a sudden scourge like that which struck Ad and Thamud.”

ayahs.arabicText: اِذْ جَآءَتْهُمُ الرُّسُلُ مِنْۢ بَیْنِ اَیْدِیْهِمْ وَ مِنْ خَلْفِهِمْ اَلَّا تَعْبُدُوْۤا اِلَّا اللّٰهَ١ؕ قَالُوْا لَوْ شَآءَ رَبُّنَا لَاَنْزَلَ مَلٰٓئِكَةً فَاِنَّا بِمَاۤ اُرْسِلْتُمْ بِهٖ كٰفِرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: When the Messengers (of Allah) came to them from the front and from the rear, saying: “Do not serve any but Allah”; they said: “Had our Lord so willed, He would have sent down angels. So we deny the Message you have brought.”

ayahs.arabicText: فَاَمَّا عَادٌ فَاسْتَكْبَرُوْا فِی الْاَرْضِ بِغَیْرِ الْحَقِّ وَ قَالُوْا مَنْ اَشَدُّ مِنَّا قُوَّةً١ؕ اَوَ لَمْ یَرَوْا اَنَّ اللّٰهَ الَّذِیْ خَلَقَهُمْ هُوَ اَشَدُّ مِنْهُمْ قُوَّةً١ؕ وَ كَانُوْا بِاٰیٰتِنَا یَجْحَدُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: As for Ad, they waxed proud in the land without justification and said: “Who is greater than we in strength?” Did they not see that Allah, Who created them, is greater in strength than they? They continued to deny Our Signs,

ayahs.arabicText: فَاَرْسَلْنَا عَلَیْهِمْ رِیْحًا صَرْصَرًا فِیْۤ اَیَّامٍ نَّحِسَاتٍ لِّنُذِیْقَهُمْ عَذَابَ الْخِزْیِ فِی الْحَیٰوةِ الدُّنْیَا١ؕ وَ لَعَذَابُ الْاٰخِرَةِ اَخْزٰى وَ هُمْ لَا یُنْصَرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: whereupon We sent upon them a fierce wind on inauspicious days that We might make them taste a degrading chastisement in the life of this world. And surely the chastisement of the Hereafter is even more degrading. There will be none to help them there.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اَمَّا ثَمُوْدُ فَهَدَیْنٰهُمْ فَاسْتَحَبُّوا الْعَمٰى عَلَى الْهُدٰى فَاَخَذَتْهُمْ صٰعِقَةُ الْعَذَابِ الْهُوْنِ بِمَا كَانُوْا یَكْسِبُوْنَۚ
ayahs.translation: As for Thamud, We bestowed guidance upon them, but they preferred to remain blind rather than be guided. At last a humiliating scourge overtook them on account of their misdeeds.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ نَجَّیْنَا الَّذِیْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَ كَانُوْا یَتَّقُوْنَ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: Yet We delivered those who believed and were God-fearing.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ یَوْمَ یُحْشَرُ اَعْدَآءُ اللّٰهِ اِلَى النَّارِ فَهُمْ یُوْزَعُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Imagine the Day when Allah's enemies will be mustered to the Fire, and the people of the former times will be detained until the arrival of people of the later times,

ayahs.arabicText: حَتّٰۤى اِذَا مَا جَآءُوْهَا شَهِدَ عَلَیْهِمْ سَمْعُهُمْ وَ اَبْصَارُهُمْ وَ جُلُوْدُهُمْ بِمَا كَانُوْا یَعْمَلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: and when all have arrived, their ears, their eyes, and their skins shall bear witness against them, stating all that they had done in the life of the world.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ قَالُوْا لِجُلُوْدِهِمْ لِمَ شَهِدْتُّمْ عَلَیْنَا١ؕ قَالُوْۤا اَنْطَقَنَا اللّٰهُ الَّذِیْۤ اَنْطَقَ كُلَّ شَیْءٍ وَّ هُوَ خَلَقَكُمْ اَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ وَّ اِلَیْهِ تُرْجَعُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: They will ask their skins: “Why did you bear witness against us?” The skins will reply: “Allah gave us speech, as He gave speech to all others. He it is Who created you for the first time and it is to Him that you will be sent back.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مَا كُنْتُمْ تَسْتَتِرُوْنَ اَنْ یَّشْهَدَ عَلَیْكُمْ سَمْعُكُمْ وَ لَاۤ اَبْصَارُكُمْ وَ لَا جُلُوْدُكُمْ وَ لٰكِنْ ظَنَنْتُمْ اَنَّ اللّٰهَ لَا یَعْلَمُ كَثِیْرًا مِّمَّا تَعْمَلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: When you used to conceal yourselves (while committing misdeeds) you never thought that your ears or your eyes or your skins would ever bear witness against you; you rather fancied that Allah does not know a great deal of what you do.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ ذٰلِكُمْ ظَنُّكُمُ الَّذِیْ ظَنَنْتُمْ بِرَبِّكُمْ اَرْدٰىكُمْ فَاَصْبَحْتُمْ مِّنَ الْخٰسِرِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: This thought of yours about your Lord has led to your perdition and you have become among the losers.”

ayahs.arabicText: فَاِنْ یَّصْبِرُوْا فَالنَّارُ مَثْوًى لَّهُمْ١ۚ وَ اِنْ یَّسْتَعْتِبُوْا فَمَا هُمْ مِّنَ الْمُعْتَبِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: In this state, whether they bear with patience (or not), Fire alone shall be their abode. And if they seek to make amends, they will not be allowed to do so.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ قَیَّضْنَا لَهُمْ قُرَنَآءَ فَزَیَّنُوْا لَهُمْ مَّا بَیْنَ اَیْدِیْهِمْ وَ مَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَ حَقَّ عَلَیْهِمُ الْقَوْلُ فِیْۤ اُمَمٍ قَدْ خَلَتْ مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ مِّنَ الْجِنِّ وَ الْاِنْسِ١ۚ اِنَّهُمْ كَانُوْا خٰسِرِیْنَ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: We had assigned to them companions who embellished for them all that was before them and behind them. Thus the same decree (of chastisement) which had overtaken the previous generations of jinn and human beings (also) became due against them. Surely they became the losers.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ قَالَ الَّذِیْنَ كَفَرُوْا لَا تَسْمَعُوْا لِهٰذَا الْقُرْاٰنِ وَ الْغَوْا فِیْهِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَغْلِبُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: The deniers of the Truth say: “Do not give ear to the Qur'an and cause interruption when it is recited; thus perhaps you will gain the upper hand.”

ayahs.arabicText: فَلَنُذِیْقَنَّ الَّذِیْنَ كَفَرُوْا عَذَابًا شَدِیْدًا١ۙ وَّ لَنَجْزِیَنَّهُمْ اَسْوَاَ الَّذِیْ كَانُوْا یَعْمَلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: We shall certainly make these unbelievers taste a terrible chastisement and shall fully requite them according to the worst deeds that they committed.

ayahs.arabicText: ذٰلِكَ جَزَآءُ اَعْدَآءِ اللّٰهِ النَّارُ١ۚ لَهُمْ فِیْهَا دَارُ الْخُلْدِ١ؕ جَزَآءًۢ بِمَا كَانُوْا بِاٰیٰتِنَا یَجْحَدُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: That is the recompense of the enemies of Allah -- the Fire, their abiding home. That will be the re-compense for their denying Our Signs.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ قَالَ الَّذِیْنَ كَفَرُوْا رَبَّنَاۤ اَرِنَا الَّذَیْنِ اَضَلّٰنَا مِنَ الْجِنِّ وَ الْاِنْسِ نَجْعَلْهُمَا تَحْتَ اَقْدَامِنَا لِیَكُوْنَا مِنَ الْاَسْفَلِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: There the unbelievers will say: “Our Lord, show us those that led us astray, both jinn and humans, and we will trample them under our feet so that they are utterly degraded.”

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّ الَّذِیْنَ قَالُوْا رَبُّنَا اللّٰهُ ثُمَّ اسْتَقَامُوْا تَتَنَزَّلُ عَلَیْهِمُ الْمَلٰٓئِكَةُ اَلَّا تَخَافُوْا وَ لَا تَحْزَنُوْا وَ اَبْشِرُوْا بِالْجَنَّةِ الَّتِیْ كُنْتُمْ تُوْعَدُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Those who say “Allah is our Lord” and then remain steadfast, upon them descend angels (and say): “Do not fear nor grieve, and receive good tidings of Paradise which you were promised.

ayahs.arabicText: نَحْنُ اَوْلِیٰٓؤُكُمْ فِی الْحَیٰوةِ الدُّنْیَا وَ فِی الْاٰخِرَةِ١ۚ وَ لَكُمْ فِیْهَا مَا تَشْتَهِیْۤ اَنْفُسُكُمْ وَ لَكُمْ فِیْهَا مَا تَدَّعُوْنَؕ
ayahs.translation: We are your companions in this world and in the Hereafter. There you shall have all that you desire and all what you will ask for.

ayahs.arabicText: نُزُلًا مِّنْ غَفُوْرٍ رَّحِیْمٍ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: This is by way of hospitality from Him Who is Most Forgiving, Most Merciful.”

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مَنْ اَحْسَنُ قَوْلًا مِّمَّنْ دَعَاۤ اِلَى اللّٰهِ وَ عَمِلَ صَالِحًا وَّ قَالَ اِنَّنِیْ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِیْنَ
ayahs.translation: And who is fairer in speech than he who calls to Allah and acts righteously and says: “I am a Muslim”?

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَا تَسْتَوِی الْحَسَنَةُ وَ لَا السَّیِّئَةُ١ؕ اِدْفَعْ بِالَّتِیْ هِیَ اَحْسَنُ فَاِذَا الَّذِیْ بَیْنَكَ وَ بَیْنَهٗ عَدَاوَةٌ كَاَنَّهٗ وَلِیٌّ حَمِیْمٌ
ayahs.translation: (O Prophet), good and evil are not equal. Repel (evil) with that which is good, and you will see that he, between whom and you there was enmity, shall become as if he were a bosom friend (of yours).

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مَا یُلَقّٰىهَاۤ اِلَّا الَّذِیْنَ صَبَرُوْا١ۚ وَ مَا یُلَقّٰىهَاۤ اِلَّا ذُوْ حَظٍّ عَظِیْمٍ
ayahs.translation: But none attains to this except those who are steadfast; none attains to this except those endowed with mighty good fortune.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اِمَّا یَنْزَغَنَّكَ مِنَ الشَّیْطٰنِ نَزْغٌ فَاسْتَعِذْ بِاللّٰهِ١ؕ اِنَّهٗ هُوَ السَّمِیْعُ الْعَلِیْمُ
ayahs.translation: And if you are prompted by a provocation from Satan, seek refuge with Allah. He, and He alone, is All-Hearing, All- Knowing.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مِنْ اٰیٰتِهِ الَّیْلُ وَ النَّهَارُ وَ الشَّمْسُ وَ الْقَمَرُ١ؕ لَا تَسْجُدُوْا لِلشَّمْسِ وَ لَا لِلْقَمَرِ وَ اسْجُدُوْا لِلّٰهِ الَّذِیْ خَلَقَهُنَّ اِنْ كُنْتُمْ اِیَّاهُ تَعْبُدُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And of His Signs are the night and the day, and the sun and the moon. Do not prostrate yourselves before the sun, nor before the moon, but prostrate yourselves before Allah Who created them, if it is Him that you serve.

ayahs.arabicText: فَاِنِ اسْتَكْبَرُوْا فَالَّذِیْنَ عِنْدَ رَبِّكَ یُسَبِّحُوْنَ لَهٗ بِالَّیْلِ وَ النَّهَارِ وَ هُمْ لَا یَسْئَمُوْنَ۩ ۞
ayahs.translation: But if they wax proud (and persist in their attitude, it does not matter, for) the angels near-stationed to your Lord glorify Him night and day, and never grow weary.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ مِنْ اٰیٰتِهٖۤ اَنَّكَ تَرَى الْاَرْضَ خَاشِعَةً فَاِذَاۤ اَنْزَلْنَا عَلَیْهَا الْمَآءَ اهْتَزَّتْ وَ رَبَتْ١ؕ اِنَّ الَّذِیْۤ اَحْیَاهَا لَمُحْیِ الْمَوْتٰى١ؕ اِنَّهٗ عَلٰى كُلِّ شَیْءٍ قَدِیْرٌ
ayahs.translation: And of His Signs is that you see the earth withered, then We send down water upon it, and lo! it quivers and swells. Surely He Who gives life to the dead earth will also give life to the dead. Surely He has power over everything.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّ الَّذِیْنَ یُلْحِدُوْنَ فِیْۤ اٰیٰتِنَا لَا یَخْفَوْنَ عَلَیْنَا١ؕ اَفَمَنْ یُّلْقٰى فِی النَّارِ خَیْرٌ اَمْ مَّنْ یَّاْتِیْۤ اٰمِنًا یَّوْمَ الْقِیٰمَةِ١ؕ اِعْمَلُوْا مَا شِئْتُمْ١ۙ اِنَّهٗ بِمَا تَعْمَلُوْنَ بَصِیْرٌ
ayahs.translation: Those who pervert Our Signs are not hidden from Us. Is he who will be cast into the Fire better, or he who comes secure on the Day of Resurrection? Do as you wish; He sees all what you do.

ayahs.arabicText: اِنَّ الَّذِیْنَ كَفَرُوْا بِالذِّكْرِ لَمَّا جَآءَهُمْ١ۚ وَ اِنَّهٗ لَكِتٰبٌ عَزِیْزٌۙ
ayahs.translation: These are the ones who rejected the Good Counsel when it came to them, although it is certainly a Mighty Book.

ayahs.arabicText: لَّا یَاْتِیْهِ الْبَاطِلُ مِنْۢ بَیْنِ یَدَیْهِ وَ لَا مِنْ خَلْفِهٖ١ؕ تَنْزِیْلٌ مِّنْ حَكِیْمٍ حَمِیْدٍ
ayahs.translation: Falsehood may not enter it from the front or from the rear. It is a revelation that has been sent down from the Most Wise, the Immensely Praiseworthy.

ayahs.arabicText: مَا یُقَالُ لَكَ اِلَّا مَا قَدْ قِیْلَ لِلرُّسُلِ مِنْ قَبْلِكَ١ؕ اِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَذُوْ مَغْفِرَةٍ وَّ ذُوْ عِقَابٍ اَلِیْمٍ
ayahs.translation: (O Prophet), nothing is said to you but what was already said to the Messengers before you. Surely your Lord is the Lord of forgiveness and the Lord of grievous chastisement.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَوْ جَعَلْنٰهُ قُرْاٰنًا اَعْجَمِیًّا لَّقَالُوْا لَوْ لَا فُصِّلَتْ اٰیٰتُهٗ١ؕ ءَؔاَعْجَمِیٌّ وَّ عَرَبِیٌّ١ؕ قُلْ هُوَ لِلَّذِیْنَ اٰمَنُوْا هُدًى وَّ شِفَآءٌ١ؕ وَ الَّذِیْنَ لَا یُؤْمِنُوْنَ فِیْۤ اٰذَانِهِمْ وَقْرٌ وَّ هُوَ عَلَیْهِمْ عَمًى١ؕ اُولٰٓئِكَ یُنَادَوْنَ مِنْ مَّكَانٍۭ بَعِیْدٍ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: Had We revealed this as a non-Arabic Qur'an they would have said: “Why were its verses not clearly expounded? How strange, a non-Arabic scripture and an Arab audience!” Tell them: “It is a guidance and a healing to the believers. But to those who do not believe, it serves as a plug in their ears and a covering over their eyes. It is as if they are being called from a place far away.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَقَدْ اٰتَیْنَا مُوْسَى الْكِتٰبَ فَاخْتُلِفَ فِیْهِ١ؕ وَ لَوْ لَا كَلِمَةٌ سَبَقَتْ مِنْ رَّبِّكَ لَقُضِیَ بَیْنَهُمْ١ؕ وَ اِنَّهُمْ لَفِیْ شَكٍّ مِّنْهُ مُرِیْبٍ
ayahs.translation: And in the past We gave Moses the Book and yet it became an object of dispute. If your Lord's decree had not gone forth before, a decisive judgement would have been made among them, once and for all. Surely they are in a disquieting doubt about it.

ayahs.arabicText: مَنْ عَمِلَ صَالِحًا فَلِنَفْسِهٖ وَ مَنْ اَسَآءَ فَعَلَیْهَا١ؕ وَ مَا رَبُّكَ بِظَلَّامٍ لِّلْعَبِیْدِ
ayahs.translation: Whoever does good, does so to his own benefit; and whoever does evil, will suffer its evil consequence. Your Lord does no wrong to His servants.

ayahs.arabicText: اِلَیْهِ یُرَدُّ عِلْمُ السَّاعَةِ١ؕ وَ مَا تَخْرُجُ مِنْ ثَمَرٰتٍ مِّنْ اَكْمَامِهَا وَ مَا تَحْمِلُ مِنْ اُنْثٰى وَ لَا تَضَعُ اِلَّا بِعِلْمِهٖ١ؕ وَ یَوْمَ یُنَادِیْهِمْ اَیْنَ شُرَكَآءِیْ١ۙ قَالُوْۤا اٰذَنّٰكَ١ۙ مَا مِنَّا مِنْ شَهِیْدٍۚ
ayahs.translation: The knowledge of the Hour rests solely with Him. Not a fruit comes forth from its sheath, nor does any female conceive nor give birth to a child but it is in His knowledge. On that Day He will call out to them: “Where are those associates of Mine?” They will answer: “We have declared to You that none of us can bear witness to that.”

ayahs.arabicText: وَ ضَلَّ عَنْهُمْ مَّا كَانُوْا یَدْعُوْنَ مِنْ قَبْلُ وَ ظَنُّوْا مَا لَهُمْ مِّنْ مَّحِیْصٍ
ayahs.translation: Then all those deities whom they once used to call upon shall vanish and they will come to know for sure that there is no escape for them.

ayahs.arabicText: لَا یَسْئَمُ الْاِنْسَانُ مِنْ دُعَآءِ الْخَیْرِ١٘ وَ اِنْ مَّسَّهُ الشَّرُّ فَیَئُوْسٌ قَنُوْطٌ
ayahs.translation: Man wearies not of praying for good, but when evil visits him, he despairs and gives up all hope.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ لَئِنْ اَذَقْنٰهُ رَحْمَةً مِّنَّا مِنْۢ بَعْدِ ضَرَّآءَ مَسَّتْهُ لَیَقُوْلَنَّ هٰذَا لِیْ١ۙ وَ مَاۤ اَظُنُّ السَّاعَةَ قَآئِمَةً١ۙ وَّ لَئِنْ رُّجِعْتُ اِلٰى رَبِّیْۤ اِنَّ لِیْ عِنْدَهٗ لَلْحُسْنٰى١ۚ فَلَنُنَبِّئَنَّ الَّذِیْنَ كَفَرُوْا بِمَا عَمِلُوْا١٘ وَ لَنُذِیْقَنَّهُمْ مِّنْ عَذَابٍ غَلِیْظٍ
ayahs.translation: And if We bestow Our Mercy upon him after hardship, he will surely say: “This is what I truly deserve, and I do not believe that the Hour (of Resurrection) will ever come to pass; and if I am returned to my Lord, there too I shall enjoy the best.” Surely We shall fully apprise the unbelievers of what they have done, and We shall certainly make them taste a severe chastisement.

ayahs.arabicText: وَ اِذَاۤ اَنْعَمْنَا عَلَى الْاِنْسَانِ اَعْرَضَ وَ نَاٰ بِجَانِبِهٖ١ۚ وَ اِذَا مَسَّهُ الشَّرُّ فَذُوْ دُعَآءٍ عَرِیْضٍ
ayahs.translation: When We bestow Our favour upon man, he turns away and waxes proud; but when a misfortune touches him, he is full of supplication.

ayahs.arabicText: قُلْ اَرَءَیْتُمْ اِنْ كَانَ مِنْ عِنْدِ اللّٰهِ ثُمَّ كَفَرْتُمْ بِهٖ مَنْ اَضَلُّ مِمَّنْ هُوَ فِیْ شِقَاقٍۭ بَعِیْدٍ
ayahs.translation: Tell them, (O Prophet): “Did you ever consider: if this Qur'an is indeed from Allah and you still deny it, who can be in greater error than he who goes far in fiercely opposing it?”

ayahs.arabicText: سَنُرِیْهِمْ اٰیٰتِنَا فِی الْاٰفَاقِ وَ فِیْۤ اَنْفُسِهِمْ حَتّٰى یَتَبَیَّنَ لَهُمْ اَنَّهُ الْحَقُّ١ؕ اَوَ لَمْ یَكْفِ بِرَبِّكَ اَنَّهٗ عَلٰى كُلِّ شَیْءٍ شَهِیْدٌ
ayahs.translation: Soon shall We show them Our Signs on the horizons and in their own beings until it becomes clear to them that it is the Truth. Is it not enough that your Lord is a witness over everything?

ayahs.arabicText: اَلَاۤ اِنَّهُمْ فِیْ مِرْیَةٍ مِّنْ لِّقَآءِ رَبِّهِمْ١ؕ اَلَاۤ اِنَّهٗ بِكُلِّ شَیْءٍ مُّحِیْطٌ۠ ۧ
ayahs.translation: Lo, they are in doubt concerning their meeting with their Lord. Surely He fully encompasses everything.
